```bash
python3 << 'PY'
import os, re, yaml
from pathlib import Path
notes = Path('/home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/content/english/notes')
files = sorted([p for p in notes.glob('[jkl]*.md')])
print(f'count={len(files)}')
for p in files:
    text = p.read_text()
    if not text.startswith('---'):
        print(f'{p.name}: NO FRONTMATTER')
        continue
    end = text.find('\n---', 3)
    fm = text[4:end]
    # extract levels and key_concept roughly
    def grab(key):
        m = re.search(rf'^{re.escape(key)}:\s*(.*)$', fm, re.M)
        if not m: return None
        val = m.group(1).strip()
        if val in ('|', '>') :
            # multiline - take until next top-level key
            start = m.end()
            rest = fm[start:]
            lines = []
            for line in rest.splitlines():
                if re.match(r'^[a-z_]+:', line):
                    break
                lines.append(line)
            return '\n'.join(lines).strip()
        # quoted string may span? usually one line
        if val.startswith('"') and not val.endswith('"'):
            start = m.start(1)
            # find closing
            chunk = fm[m.start(1):]
            qm = re.match(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"', chunk, re.S)
            if qm: return qm.group(0)[1:-1]
        return val.strip('"')
    kc = grab('key_concept')
    l1 = grab('level_1')
    l2 = grab('level_2')
    l3 = grab('level_3')
    l4 = grab('level_4')
    l5 = grab('level_5')
    missing = [k for k,v in [('l1',l1),('l2',l2),('l3',l3),('l4',l4),('l5',l5)] if not v]
    print('='*60)
    print(p.name)
    if missing: print('MISSING:', missing)
    # first line of key_concept
    if kc:
        first = kc.splitlines()[0].lstrip('- ').strip()
        print(f'KC1: {first[:120]}')
    for i,v in enumerate([l1,l2,l3,l4,l5],1):
        print(f'L{i}: {(v or "MISSING")[:160]}')
```
